about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Pour into us, Lord, the Spirit of Your love, so that through Your loving kindness You may make of one heart those whom You have satisfied with the paschal sacraments. Through Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who, as God, lives and reigns with You in the unity of the same Holy Spirit forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: Pour into us, Lord, the Spirit of Your love
You have satisfied with the paschal sacraments
You may make of one heart through Your loving kindness
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the same Holy Spirit

w006.explanation: Infunde asks God to pour His Spirit into us. Nobis identifies us as the recipients, and tuae caritatis describes the Spirit of His love.

w013.explanation: Facias is a request addressed to God. Concordes describes those whom He has satisfied as united in heart.

w033.explanation: Deus names Jesus Christ as God.
